source: Uranium appears in the molten iron and nickel of earth's outer core. Superheated Uranium undergoes nuclear fission through an atomic chain reaction. A gigaton explosion of lava and heat energy surges towards the earth’s crust.
target: 鈾出現在地球外核熔融的鐵與鎳之中。 熾熱的鈾透過原子連鎖反應發生核分裂。 十億噸級的爆炸，將熔岩與熱能推向地殼。

source: Dormant and active volcanoes simultaneously erupt across the world. Along with trace Uranium particles, enormous amounts of volcanic gas and ash are injected into the stratosphere. The planet burps. Earth temperatures cool as atmospheric ash impedes sunlight for half of a year. Wildlife and vegetation die en masse. Ash and drought create dusty wastelands.
target: 世界各地的休火山與活火山同時噴發。 伴隨微量鈾粒子，巨量火山氣體與灰燼被噴入平流層。 這顆星球打了個嗝。 大氣中的火山灰遮蔽陽光長達半年，地球氣溫下降。野生動物與植被大量死亡。 灰燼與乾旱，造就了塵土飛揚的荒地。

source: Dove panics and flies erratically from the sudden shift in environment: snow and night in the depths of a pine forest. Wind brings the smell of ash. The freezing dove turns to the smoke and flies towards an amber glow, towards a growing warmth, towards the grey plumes of a burning structure. A log cabin on fire. Dove takes rest on a pine branch above the blaze. Branch creaks from the heavy, melting snow. Dove splays its wings to warm and dry its feathers. Dove jumps to the sky as the pine branch cracks, snaps, and falls to collapse a wall of the burning log cabin below. A human stumbles from the burning building and rolls wildly in the snow. The human rests on his back, heaving, gulping air. Dove lands on another branch and again tries to warm its feathers.
target: 環境驟變，鴿子驚慌失措地亂飛：牠來到松林深處的雪夜。 風帶來灰燼的氣味。凍得發抖的鴿子轉向煙霧，飛向琥珀色的光芒，飛向漸濃的暖意，飛向一棟燃燒建築冒出的灰煙。一間著火的小木屋。 鴿子停在火焰上方的松枝歇息。厚重的融雪壓得枝條嘎吱作響。鴿子張開雙翼，暖暖身子，也烘乾羽毛。 松枝裂開、折斷，落下砸塌了燃燒木屋的一面牆，鴿子也騰空飛起。 一個人踉蹌地逃出燃燒的建築，在雪地裡拚命打滾。那人仰躺下來，胸膛劇烈起伏，大口吸氣。 鴿子落在另一根樹枝上，再次試著暖和羽毛。

source: Yira: Exactly! A circular flow of time implies that everything in the past was meant to happen to create the future, and everything in the future was meant to happen to create the past, on and on, flowing in a great circuit! All is *cough-COUGH-cough-cough* predestined!
target: 伊拉：沒錯！時間循環流動，意味著過去的一切注定要發生，才能創造未來；而未來的一切也注定要發生，才能創造過去。如此不斷，沿著一個巨大的環路流動！一切都＊咳——咳咳——咳咳＊早已注定！

source: Yira: Now listen with *cough-COUGH* your heart, Mo. This is the most important implication: I believe that with this theoretical framework, we may be able to map time by hypothetically calculating the dimensional relationship between our experimental data poimts. It's like how my father connected *cough* stars of varying distances to create a recognizable constellation that moves predictably. We connect our data like constellations and relate it to our knowledge of history, of how the world has changed, to generate an approximate map of time. And then – Ahoo! – then with a map, we can potentially see the events that shape the flow of our timeline.
target: 伊拉：現在，用心＊咳——咳咳＊聽，莫。這是最重要的推論：我相信，有了這個理論架構，我們或許能假設並計算實驗資料點之間的維度關係，藉此繪出時間的地圖。就像我父親把距離各異的＊咳＊星星連起來，形成可辨認、運行可預測的星座。我們像連星座一樣串起數據，再與已知的歷史、世界變化的知識對照，就能產生一幅概略的時間地圖。然後——啊哈！——有了地圖，我們便可能看見那些塑造時間線流向的事件。

source: Yira: Even that little pinecone and stick you saw me toss into the very first portal – all of it – inflection points within the spinning ring of past-present-future-past. Events that always had to occur for us to end up in the time-state we are in now.
target: 伊拉：甚至你看見我丟進第一道傳送門的小毬果與樹枝——所有這些——都是過去、現在、未來、過去這個旋轉環路裡的轉折點。這些事件始終非得發生不可，我們才會來到此刻所處的時間狀態。

source: Moharan Praetis: Stone Age what?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：石器時代的什麼？

source: Yira: Mo, my sweet Mo I’ve unified the data. I have a theory, no – I have THE theory.
target: 伊拉：莫，親愛的莫，我把數據統合起來了。我有個理論，不——我找到了那個理論。

source: Moharan Praetis: Means that, in a circular framework, we were meant to possess it all along…
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：意味著，在循環的架構下，我們從一開始就注定會擁有它……

source: Yira: Ah yes, heh. I suppose that’s important. Make us some *cough-COUGH* soup, dear. I’ll tell you all about my journey with this little gem. A journey across thousands of years…
target: 伊拉：啊，對，呵。我想，那很重要。親愛的，替我們煮點＊咳——咳咳＊湯吧。我會把我和這顆小寶石的旅程全告訴你。一段橫跨數千年的旅程……

source: Moharan Praetis: So our experiments were meant to happen… they HAD to happen…
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：所以，我們的實驗注定要發生……它們非發生不可……

source: Yira: Mmm, I knew you’d grasp it, my dear. And last but not least *cough*, here… the green gem is yours. Along with the destiny of our work. No pressure, heh. I’m satisfied, I think. I’m slowly on my way to meet my Apa, my Stone Age father, Hrokk.. .
target: 伊拉：嗯，我就知道你會懂，親愛的。還有最後一件重要的事＊咳＊，來……綠色寶石歸你了。我們研究的命運，也交給你。別有壓力，呵。我想，我已經心滿意足了。我正在慢慢走向我的阿爸，我石器時代的父親，赫洛克……

source: Moharan Praetis: Are you coughing up blood ? Yira… you’re scaring me, what are you saying?

source: Yira: Oh, the Mad Queen is free! I’m almost *COUGH-cough-cough* finished! I’m just about done!
target: 伊拉：噢，瘋女王自由了！我差不多＊咳咳——咳——咳＊完成了！我就快完成了！

source: Moharan Praetis: Yira! You’re still clacking away at your digi-notes? This is a week now where you’re hardly leaving your office—fwah, what’s the awful smell? Have you bathed? Is that blood on those tissues?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：伊拉！妳還在劈哩啪啦地打電子筆記？這都一個星期了，妳幾乎沒離開過辦公室——哇，什麼味道這麼臭？妳洗過澡嗎？那些紙巾上的是血嗎？

source: Moharan Praetis: This can wait, we must see a doc—

source: Yira: No! I want you to hear this from me first. I am dying, but that’s okay. Shh!--- listen. The radioactive materials I’ve handled for experiments are taking their toll. I accept it. I accept it *cough-cough* wholeheartedly because I believe I finally understand the framework of the data, the framework of…
target: 伊拉：不！我要先親口告訴你。我快死了，但沒關係。噓！——聽我說。實驗中經手的放射性物質，正開始討回代價。我接受。我＊咳咳＊打從心底接受，因為我相信自己終於理解了數據的架構，理解了……

source: Moharan Praetis: Let’s get you some fresh air…
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：我們帶妳出去透透氣……

source: Moharan Praetis: Guff me… and these events ensure that we – humanity as we know it – come to exist in our current state of prosperity. So… so you’re telling me that this map of time can show us how we need to affect time so we end up with Quent?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：我的媽啊……而這些事件確保我們——我們所知的人類——能以如今繁榮的樣貌存在。所以……所以妳是說，這張時間地圖能告訴我們，該如何影響時間，才能讓昆特誕生？

source: Yira: NO! Mo, please. Listen to a dying old woman! I’ve developed a theoretical paradigm called the Chaos Theses. Do you know why *cough* we struggled to connect our data? Because we assumed time was linear when the temporal dimension is circular, spherical. Time flows not on a plane, but looping within itself! I was holding the idea *cough* all along – the gem! The very fact we possess this portal-ripping green crystal—
target: 伊拉：不行！莫，拜託。聽聽一個將死的老太婆吧！我建立了一套理論範式，叫作《混沌論》。你知道為什麼＊咳＊我們一直難以串聯數據嗎？因為我們假定時間是線性的，但時間這個維度其實是環形、球形的。時間不是在平面上流動，而是在自身之中循環！這個概念，我其實一直＊咳＊握在手裡——寶石！光是我們擁有這顆能撕開傳送門的綠色水晶，就——

source: Moharan Praetis: But it's possible? You think you can do it?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：但這是可能的？妳認為自己辦得到？

source: Moharan Praetis: …Fine. Yes, fine. I’ll brief the team tonight and we’ll prepare to begin as soon as possible.
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：……好吧。對，好吧。我今晚會向團隊說明，我們會準備盡快開始。

source: Pitra-Patra: Ten years, I believe. If my processors are efficiently recycled.
target: 皮特拉・帕特拉：我認為需要十年。前提是我的處理器能有效率地循環運作。

source: Pitra-Patra: If the goal is a mathematical map that extrapolates how an event in time affects other events in time, yes. Our experiment data is just enough for me to get started. Though the scope of the map is limited to all of the knowledge of our past and our present.
target: 皮特拉・帕特拉：如果目標是建立數學地圖，推算時間中的某個事件如何影響其他事件，那麼可以。我們的實驗數據勉強足以讓我開始。不過，地圖的範圍僅限於我們對過去與現在所知的一切。

source: Moharan Praetis: You’re attempting a joke, right? You believe it will take TEN YEARS for you to process a theoretical map of critical temporal events from the experiment data?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：妳是在試著開玩笑，對吧？妳認為，光是根據實驗數據算出關鍵時間事件的理論地圖，就得花上整整十年？

source: Pitra-Patra: Yes, if my processors are cooled and cleaned intermittently across that time. Respectfully, you cannot perceive the vast amount of mathematical computing required for this undertaking. I will have to enter a hibernation of pure calculation. I will have to divert all power to creating and testing many theoretical algorithms, simultaneously. Analogy: you must map all the things in a dark room of an unknown size, and all you know is that there is a room and there are near-infinite, small things that are moving about in undefined paths.
target: 皮特拉・帕特拉：是的，前提是在這段期間定期冷卻、清潔我的處理器。恕我直言，你無法想像這項工作需要多麼龐大的數學運算。我必須進入只進行計算的休眠狀態。我必須把所有電力投入，同時建立並測試大量理論演算法。打個比方：你得繪出一間大小未知的暗室裡的所有東西，而你只知道有這麼一間房間，裡面有近乎無限的小物件，正沿著未定的路徑四處移動。

source:
If you consider chasing me, know this: ever since Pitra-Patra began to process a temporal map, I devoted all of my spare moments to studying three dozen key languages, customs, and societies from the past. I am an expert on major societies that existed between the years 2000-2200. Though I do aim to protect the Crux Foci Everly Praetis, that is not my primary objective. 

I will do everything in my power to enlighten the people of the past to the dangers of time manipulation. 

If the Quentinites taught us anything, it’s that one idea can shape history. 

Forget the 4th.
target:
若你們打算追來，請先明白：自從皮特拉・帕特拉開始計算時間地圖，我就把所有空閒都用來研讀過去三十六種重要的語言、習俗與社會。我是西元 2000 至 2200 年間主要社會的專家。雖然我確實打算保護樞紐焦點艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯，但那不是我的首要目標。

我會竭盡所能，讓過去的人們明白操弄時間的危險。

如果昆汀修士曾教會我們什麼，那就是：一個念頭，就能塑造歷史。

忘掉第四維。

source:
My name is Zebna Elykraton. If you are reading this, then you won’t be for much longer.

I used the green gem to open and go through the time portal. I carry with me a mission: to eliminate the Temporal Cathedral and cease all meddling in temporal dimensions. Trying to stop me would be futile. I have prepared for this mission for nearly ten years.
 
Before you knew me as a fellow researcher in the Temporal Cathedral, before I was the top student at Exomnus Academy, I was and always will be an acolyte to Master F. He showed me what it means to live above pity, and he opened my mind to the dark history – the inevitable pattern in our past
target:
我叫潔布娜・伊利克拉頓。如果你們正在讀這段話，那你們也讀不了多久了。

我用綠色寶石開啟時間傳送門，並穿了過去。我肩負著一項使命：消滅時間大教堂，終止一切對時間維度的干涉。想阻止我是徒勞的。我已為這項使命準備了近十年。

在你們認識我這個時間大教堂的研究夥伴以前，在我成為艾克索姆學院的頂尖學生以前，我就是 F 大師的門徒，而且永遠都是。他讓我明白，不受憐憫束縛地活著是什麼意思，也讓我看清了黑暗的歷史——過去那個必然反覆出現的模式：

source:
where human hubris causes civilization collapse. The human species is not meant to meddle in the flow of time. Humanity, as finite beings, must cultivate the pure enjoyment of the present! 

Moharan Praetis and Kwalan Wey’tuta, I bear no ill will towards either of you. I consider you both to be as immensely brilliant as you are misguided. Who can fault you for your untempered curiosity in a society that breeds this attitude?
 
If you are reading this, you have awoken from a catatonic slumber that I induced using gamma-hydroxybutyrate powder. A compound provided by Master F. I’ve watched your habits and your routines. It was simple to spike your evening teas – the same ones you take after recording the day’s research.
target:
人類的傲慢導致文明崩潰。人類本就不該干涉時間的流動。身為有限的存在，人類必須學會純粹享受當下！

莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯、夸蘭・韋圖塔，我對你們都沒有惡意。在我眼中，你們才智非凡，卻也同樣誤入歧途。在一個助長這種態度的社會，誰能責怪你們毫無節制的好奇心呢？

如果你們正在讀這段話，表示你們已經從我用 γ－羥基丁酸粉末誘發的昏沉睡眠中醒來。那是 F 大師提供的化合物。我觀察過你們的習慣與作息。要在你們每晚記錄完當日研究後喝的茶裡下藥，再簡單不過。

source: I can’t keep living like this! Huddled in an obsidian cave among dry leaves and dead grasses. No food or water reserves. This smoked fish will last me another meal… maybe. The locals – who are they? As closely as I watch and listen, their speech sounds nothing like the dozens of languages most common during the time of the Foci Crux. Do I keep trying to rely on the universal communication of Morse code? Ancient people used and recognized it across centuries… The possibility that I’m in the wrong era scares me to death… but the mission stands. I have to plant the seed of the idea: meddling in the flow of time is the cause of human destruction. Forget the 4th. My encounter today was awful. I spotted teenage boys fishing in the pool of a stream, and I hoped they’d be less flighty than the children I contacted a few days before. I emerged from bushes on the other side of the stream, tried to wave a greeting and vocalized the Morse S-O-S pattern — "ah-ah-ah, eee-eee-eee, ah-ah-ah." But they pointed at my hand, shouted with fright, and fled without their belongings. They were so startled that they left their caught trout on the banks. My latest meal. It grows colder. My freeze-dried rations ran out three days ago. The few handfuls of blackberries I’ve found have held me over but, even with this trout, the hunger never ceases and I’m at risk of dehydration. Were it not for my fire, I’d have long been torn up by the wolves, bears, or mountain lions. There’s no other option. I must try to contact and join these people.
target: 我不能再這樣活下去了！蜷縮在黑曜石洞穴裡，身邊只有枯葉與乾草。沒有儲備的食物或水。這條燻魚還能讓我撐一餐……也許吧。 當地人——他們究竟是誰？無論我多仔細觀察、聆聽，他們說的話都不像樞紐焦點那個年代最常見的數十種語言。我還要繼續依靠摩斯電碼這種共通的溝通方式嗎？幾個世紀以來，古人一直使用它，也認得它…… 一想到自己可能來錯時代，我就怕得要死……但使命不變。我必須播下這個念頭的種子：干涉時間的流動，就是人類毀滅的根源。忘掉第四維。 今天的遭遇糟透了。我看見幾個少年在溪潭釣魚，心想他們應該不會像幾天前接觸的孩子那樣，一下就跑掉。我從溪流對岸的灌木叢走出來，試著揮手打招呼，再用聲音發出摩斯電碼 S－O－S 的節奏——「啊啊啊，咿——咿——咿——，啊啊啊。」但他們指著我的手，驚恐地大叫，連東西都沒拿就逃了。他們嚇得連釣到的鱒魚都丟在岸上。成了我最近的一餐。 天氣愈來愈冷。 我的冷凍乾燥口糧三天前就吃光了。找到的幾把黑莓讓我勉強撐著，但即使有了這條鱒魚，飢餓仍未停歇，我也面臨脫水的危險。要不是生了火，我早就被狼、熊或美洲獅撕碎了。 沒有別的選擇。我必須試著接觸並加入這群人。
